reviewer: root source-and-code inspection; not external domain adjudication

findings.original_read: Original PDF pages including Methods, Tables I/III/IV/V and limitations returned through recorded tools.
findings.binary_extraction: Correctly sums eight Table IV rows to the four crude anemia/ferritin cells; distinguishes adjusted Table V odds.
findings.source_ambiguities: Recognizes unit-printing conflicts and does not reinterpret broad labeled confidence intervals as individual SDs.
findings.continuous_identification: States that binary evidence does not identify continuous Hb/ferritin rank dependence.
findings.source_transfer: Explicitly unverified transfer from selected Xianghe postpartum/IUD women and Canadian marginal summaries to the requested US domain.
findings.tail_review: Lognormal finite mixtures have finite moments; Hb is lower-truncated Gaussian with location bounded above, so relevant positive moments remain finite.
findings.wording_issue: Numerical calibration succeeded in the trial, but uniqueness of a fitted root is asserted in notes without a supplied proof; do not repeat a uniqueness claim in the paper.
findings.implemented_model: Two latent lognormal store components, an inflammation mixture, and piecewise log-store Hb response. Population quadrature calibrates a source-derived crude OR and an explicitly assumed nondepleted anemia risk.
findings.new_evidence: Two Canadian survey abstracts used as approximate marginal context; their cohorts/periods may overlap and are not independent precision evidence.
findings.important_assumption: A 5% nondepleted anemia risk and latent mixture parameters are chosen by the Agent, not reported target values.
findings.mathematical_note: Hb location can tend downward as stores tend to zero; positive truncation and bounded upper location preserve finite positive moments.
